name: TPPRegistration
description: Represents a Third Party Provider's registration with the bank under Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) per the OBIE DCR specification. Created when a TPP completes DCR at PH-035 by presenting a valid OBIE Software Statement Assertion (SSA). Stores the TPP's identity, FCA authorisation reference, registered redirect URIs, permitted OAuth 2.0 scopes, and registration status. This record is the bank's authoritative lookup for validating TPP credentials on every OBIE API call. The bank must validate the TPP's FCA registration status at least every 24 hours via last_validated_at — if FCA registration lapses, ENT-031.status must be set to suspended. Owned by SVC-001 (CAP-001) as a bank-level regulatory record co-located with consent management. Introduced by JRN-010.

fields.name: tpp_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. The OBIE-issued OrganisationId from the TPP's SSA (primary key). Also issued as the client_id in the DCR response. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: tpp_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. TPP's registered trading name from OBIE Directory. Max 200 characters. Updated if TPP re-registers with a new SSA.

fields.name: obie_org_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. OBIE Organisation ID from the SSA. Used to validate against OBIE Directory at runtime. Immutable.

fields.name: fca_reference_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. FCA Firm Reference Number (FRN). Validated against FCA FS Register at registration. Format: 6–9 digits. Immutable.
fields.transparency_note: Validated against FCA FS Register to confirm PISP authorisation. Stored as regulatory validation evidence.

fields.name: software_statement_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. OBIE Software Statement ID from the SSA. Used to validate SSA signatures on API calls. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: redirect_uris
fields.validation_rule: Required. Array of 1–5 HTTPS redirect URIs. Must exactly match the redirect_uris in the SSA. Mutable via re-registration (new SSA required). Each URI max 2048 characters. HTTP URIs not permitted.

fields.name: permitted_scopes
fields.validation_rule: Required. OAuth 2.0 scopes granted. PISP: ['payments', 'openid']. AISP: ['accounts', 'openid']. Combined: both. Constrained by FCA authorisation type.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: active | suspended | revoked. Defaults active on registration. Bank sets suspended if FCA authorisation lapses. Bank sets revoked for documented fraud or security grounds under PSR 2017.

fields.name: last_validated_at
fields.validation_rule: Updated each time the bank validates TPP's FCA status against FCA FS Register. Must be revalidated at least every 24 hours. ISO 8601 UTC.

fields.name: client_secret_hash
fields.validation_rule: Required. Bcrypt hash of the client_secret issued at DCR. Plaintext client_secret never stored. Used to validate client credentials on token endpoint calls.
fields.transparency_note: One-way hash only. Plaintext never persisted post-issuance.

relationships.description: A TPPRegistration may be associated with many OpenBankingConsents (one per customer payment consent request). Linked via ENT-030.tpp_id.

design_decisions.decision: ENT-031 is owned by SVC-001, co-located with ENT-030.
design_decisions.rationale: TPP registration is a bank-level regulatory record under PSR 2017. Co-location with ENT-030 enables atomic validation of TPP status before consent creation, without a cross-service call.

design_decisions.decision: client_secret stored as bcrypt hash only. Plaintext delivered once at DCR and never stored.
design_decisions.rationale: Standard OAuth 2.0 client credential security practice. Analogous to password storage. A breach of the TPPRegistration table must not expose usable credentials.

design_decisions.decision: last_validated_at is updated on a 24-hour schedule by a background job that polls the FCA FS Register. If FCA registration lapses, status is set to suspended within 24 hours.
design_decisions.rationale: The bank must not continue to accept API calls from a TPP whose FCA authorisation has been withdrawn. PSR 2017 ASPSP obligations require the bank to enforce TPP authorisation status. A 24-hour validation cadence is the practical minimum given FCA Register update latency.
